[quote=koranvistan;61094585][i]"Sounds like that's the move. Shall we?"[/i] She gestured towards the way they came, back down the winding path. The spring air had begun turning cool and misty as the moon rose over the night. The inside of her car was personalized to the teeth- the finishing touch a vanity plate reading (essentially) "LzQnn". There were fuzzy, purple seat covers inside and a charm hanging from the rearview mirror- the necklace she wore through the liberation. The soft interior was decorated with oddball graphic designs she had done some afternoon while enjoying a chat and a blunt with her dad. Her business vehicle, obviously, was much more modest.
...
[i]"So high school, right?"[/i] Elena started as they headed towards the palace, [i]"Right in the middle of our winter festival, a bunch of kids lined up and down the street serving food and drinks in town, carols, folk songs, quite a memory. Some of us seniors came from a party at Gilda's instead of the school. This boy I hadn't hardly spoken to showed up with an [b]owl[/b], and it was flying around, landing on students, whatever- Guy was handing out [b]party invites[/b], which I found out after getting an uh... avian haircut, as it were."[/i]
...
When they arrived, she led Cecilia up to a room on the second floor, her study. She pulled a few bottles and glasses from a cabinet she keeps by the desk. [i]"My dear, I've got a couple options but I can get a water or something if you'd like. Whiskey, rum? Something mixed?"[/i] She poured herself a short glass of whiskey and waited quietly for an answer.[/quote]
Cecilia noticed the interior decorations of the car, and softly smiled. She listened attentively to the story Elena told during the drive, laughing at the end. [i]Girl, I [b]need[/b] to attend one of these Koranian winter festivals,[/i] she said in between laughs.

At the study, after a bit of thought, Cecilia answered. [i]Ill take some red wine, please.[/i] She leaned slightly against a wall, watching Elena pour the drinks.

[spoiler=[b]Trade and Diplomatic Cooperation Treaty[/b]
[i]Between Luscária and Meritava
Date: August 9th, 2027[/i]]

[b]Preamble[/b]

Recognizing the mutual benefits to be attained from expanded trade, industrial cooperation, and long-term partnership, the Paramount State of Luscária and the Tsardom of Meritava, henceforth referred to as the Parties, have agreed as follows:

[b]Title I - General Provisions[/b]

[i]Section 1.01 - Purpose[/i]
This agreement establishes a framework regarding the tariffs, diplomatic relations, bilateral trade of goods, industrial investment, and surplus settlement mechanisms between Luscária and Meritava.

[i]Section 1.02 - Duration[/i]
This agreement shall come into effect upon ratification by both Parties and shall remain in effect for an initial period of ten (10) years, renewable by mutual consent.

[b]Title II - Embassy Exchange[/b]

1. Luscária will host a Meritavan Embassy, Meritava will be responsible for the fiscal needs of the embassy, while Luscária is required to offer basic services to the hosted embassy.

2. Meritava will host a Luscárian Embassy, Luscária will be responsible for the fiscal needs of the embassy, while Meritava is required to offer basic services to the hosted embassy.

[b]Title III - Resource Trade & Tariffs[/b]

[i]Section 3.01 - Imports (Meritava -> Luscária)[/i]
Luscária shall import the following goods from Meritava at negotiated long-term contract rates.

 Gold: 280 tons ($28 billion)
 Potatoes: 1.8 million tons ($450 million)
 Carrots: 620,000 tons ($186 million)
 Beets: 510,000 tons ($144 million)
 Berries: 320,000 tons ($576 million)
 Fur: 3.6 million pelts ($800 million)
 Oxen: 105,000 head ($200 million)
 Blubber: 160,000 tons ($200 million)

Estimated Total Value: $30.556 billion annually

[i]Section 3.02 - Exports (Luscária -> Meritava)[/i]
Luscária shall export the following goods to Meritava under the same negotiated rates.

 Uranium: 2,600 tons ($468 million)
 Copper: 510,000 tons ($5.51 billion)
 Zinc: 430,000 tons ($1.16 billion)
 Phosphorus: 1.4 million tons ($1 billion)
 Chicken: 1.1 million tons ($2.42 billion)
 Cheese: 380,000 tons ($1.82 billion)
 Sugar: 2.9 million tons ($1.48 billion)
 Rice: 3.4 million tons ($2 billion)
 Mangoes: 1.05 million tons ($1.36 billion)
 Coconuts: 1.8 million tons ($756 million)
 Consumer electronics: $11.28 billion
 Industrial electronics: $4.36 billion
 Semiconductors: $12.48 billion

Estimated Total Value: $46.094 billion annually

[i]Section 3.03 - Pricing & Delivery[/i]
1. Prices shall be benchmarked against international standards and adjusted biennially by mutual agreement of the Parties.

2. The aforementioned quantities shall be delivered on an annual basis.

[i]Section 3.04 - Tariffs[/i]
1. The Paramount State of Luscária will permit a base level tariff of 2.5% on goods imported from the Tsardom of Meritava.

2. The Tsardom of Meritava will permit a base level tariff of 2.5% on goods imported from the Paramount State of Luscária.

[b]Title IV - Trade Balance[/b]

[i]Section 4.01 - Trade Surplus[/i]
The Parties acknowledge that the framework of trade established under this agreement results in an estimated annual surplus of $15.538 billion in favor of Luscária.

[i]Section 4.02 - Surplus Settlement[/i]
The Parties agree that the trade surplus shall be settled through a mix of industrial investment, infrastructure development, strategic cooperation, and financial transfers, as outlined below:

[b]Title V - Industrial Investment & Surplus Settlement[/b]

[i]Section 5.01 - ARVEK Industrial Investment[/i]
1. $5.836 billion of the trade surplus shall be allocated on an annual basis as industrial investment credits to ARVEK, Luscárias national defense and security manufacturer.

2. ARVEK shall be permitted to:
 Acquire land and purchase existing facilities within Meritava,
 Establish and operate manufacturing plants, assembly lines, logistics centers, and associated R&D and testing facilities,
 Establish and operate maintenance, storage, training, and other industrial support infrastructure

[i]Section 5.02 - Indra Industrial Investment[/i]
1. $3.092 billion of the trade surplus shall be allocated on an annual basis as industrial investment credits to Indra, a Luscárian defense systems manufacturer.

2. Indra shall be permitted to:
 Acquire land and purchase existing facilities within Meritava,
 Establish and operate advanced manufacturing and integration facilities, including electronics, guidance and systems integration plants,
 Establish and operate logistics, storage, and other industrial support infrastructure

[i]Section 5.03 - SG Sistemas Industrial Investment[/i]
1. $2.86 billion of the trade surplus shall be allocated on an annual basis as industrial investment credits to Santo Gerona Sistemas, a Luscárian defense manufacturer.

2. SG Sistemas shall be permitted to:
 Acquire land and purchase existing facilities within Meritava,
 Establish and operate high-capacity manufacturing facilities,
 Operate continuous cycle production plants,
 Establish and operate logistics, storage, and other industrial support infrastructure

[i]Section 5.04 - OAW Industrial Investment[/i]
1. $850 million of the trade surplus shall be allocated on an annual basis as industrial investment credits to Ostreal Automotive Works (OAW).

2. OAW shall be permitted to acquire land, purchase existing facilities, and establish automotive manufacturing plants, headquarters, and associated R&D facilities within Meritava. 

[i]Section 5.05 - Infrastructure Offsets[/i]
$2.1 billion of the annual trade surplus shall be settled through infrastructure projects in Meritava, including but not limited to:
 Transport networks,
 Ports,
 Energy facilities,
 Logistics infrastructure.

[i]Section 5.06 - Partial Financial Settlement[/i]
$800 million of the annual trade surplus shall be settled through direct financial and currency transfers between the Parties.

[i]Section 5.07 - Total Settlement[/i]
The Parties affirm that the above mechanisms fully settle the $15.538 billion annual trade surplus.

[b]Title VI - Final Provisions[/b]

1. This agreement may be amended through written consent of both Parties.

2. Any disputes caused by this agreement are to be resolved through diplomatic consultation.

3. Both Parties commit to the implementation of this agreement in good faith and in a manner consistent with its objectives.

[b]Signatures[/b]

[i]Signed on behalf of the Paramount State of Luscária,[/i]
Caudillo Manuel A. Torres

[i]Signed on behalf of the Tsardom of Meritava,[/i]
Tsar Aleksandr I Meritavsky
[/spoiler]
